fire.description: Triggered when player or enemy gun fires. Hooks: bullet spawn, muzzle flash FX, shot sfx.

hit.description: Triggered on impact. Hooks: hit spark FX, silhouette flash, haptic feedback.

explode.description: Triggered at the peak of the death animation. Hooks: explosion particle burst, screen shake, kill sfx.

shake_small.description: Minor camera shake for small hits or near misses.

shake_big.description: Major camera shake for Boss hits or Big Wins.

spawn_fx.description: Generic hook to spawn a separate Spine FX at a bone location.
